nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the contract owner; set in constructor from msg.sender and updatable via setNewOwner, used in the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
Public uint256 state variable holding the fee required to register (initialized to 0.1 ether in constructor); read by getRegistrationFee and by register, writable via setNewRegistrationPrice.
Public mapping(address => bool) tracking whether an address has registered; written in register once per msg.sender.
Constructor initializing owner = msg.sender and registrationFee = 0.1 ether.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain value transfers and unknown calls.
Public view getter returning the current registrationFee.
Public view getter returning the current owner address.
Owner-restricted setter that changes the owner state variable to _newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner (require msg.sender == owner).
Owner-restricted setter that updates registrationFee to _newFee; guarded by onlyOwner (require msg.sender == owner).
Payable function accepting at least registrationFee and marking isUserRegistered[msg.sender] = true; requires caller not already registered.
Owner-restricted function that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender via an external payable transfer; guarded by onlyOwner.

External caller-supplied address; used as owner in constructor, as the key into isUserRegistered in register, as the access-control subject in onlyOwner, and as the recipient of the withdraw transfer.
External value-transfer operation in withdraw: payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance), sending the full contract balance to the owner.
Address parameter of setNewOwner; assigned directly to the owner state variable.
uint256 parameter of setNewRegistrationPrice; assigned directly to the registrationFee state variable.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, writing the owner state variable.
Constructor initializes registrationFee to 0.1 ether.
msg.sender is the value stored into owner during construction.
getRegistrationFee reads and returns the registrationFee state variable.
getOwner reads and returns the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner, gating execution of setNewOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner, gating execution of setNewRegistrationPrice.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner, gating execution of withdraw.
setNewOwner receives _newOwner as its input parameter.
_newOwner is written into the privileged owner state variable, which controls all onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier before setNewOwner body executes.
setNewRegistrationPrice receives _newFee as its input parameter.
_newFee is written into the privileged registrationFee state variable by an owner-restricted setter.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier before setNewRegistrationPrice body executes.
register writes true into isUserRegistered for the calling address.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key when reading and writing isUserRegistered.
register requires isUserRegistered[msg.sender] == false, so caller identity controls whether the function proceeds.
withdraw executes the external value transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) after checking the owner.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier before withdraw executes its transfer.
The external transfer in withdraw hands control to the recipient and could allow re-entry into withdraw or other state-changing functions before/after the balance is drained.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a function-scoped parameter whose only role is supplying the argument to setNewOwner; it should be merged into the setNewOwner function node it belongs to.
_newFee is a function-scoped parameter whose only role is supplying the argument to setNewRegistrationPrice; it should be merged into the setNewRegistrationPrice function node it belongs to.
